授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: In their professional careers, all engineers will have to make decisions that challenge them ethically. In the engineering context (and in life in general), good ethical choices can prevent significant harm from occurring to people, the environment, the companies that engineers work for, and themselves. This course is designed to provide students with an introduction to professional ethics and to provide students with a set of tools to assist them to make good decisions.
